data.name: Radhe
data.gender_notes: Radhe is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Radhe is recorded with the meaning “Joy, Delight”. Radhe is a Hindu name meaning “Joy, Delight”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Radhe expresses “Joy, Delight”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The name Radhe is recorded with the meaning “Joy, Delight”. Radhe is a Hindu name meaning “Joy, Delight”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Radhe total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_sanskrit.name: राधा
in_sanskrit.meaning: विविधा प्रकारेण सुकर्मा, सुस्नेहा, सुमनासा, सुरसाधारणा प्रभावशालिनी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has various good qualities, is sweet, affectionate, has a good disposition, and has the power to make the gods pleased.

in_hindi.name: राधे
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is beautiful, sweet, has good deeds, and is worthy of worship by the gods.

in_tamil.name: ராதே
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who bestows boons, one who is the giver of blessings, one who is the goddess of love.

in_telugu.name: రాధే
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is worthy of worship, one who is the goddess of love, one who is the embodiment of grace, and one who is the goddess of wealth.

in_marathi.name: Radhe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Radhe हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who provides joy and delight, manifestation of Radha, a form of Goddess Lakshmi and Krishna's eternal lover

in_bengali.name: Radhe
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joy, Delight
in_bengali.long_meaning: Radhe একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who provides joy and delight, manifestation of Radha, a form of Goddess Lakshmi and Krishna's eternal lover
